transport.config_rules: Byte/count values are positive integers; timeout is finite and positive. Defaults allow existing 1 MiB send chunks. No manifest/config fixture changes.
transport.semantics: Payload byte/chunk/part limits are cumulative across parts. Server buffer budget includes reports plus active, queued and retained completed wire bytes without double-counting queued completed values. Incomplete-transfer deadline is absolute and expires without another message. Client inbound transfer and simulation-file reads are bounded by configured payload caps.
transport.s3: Existing presigned-object format/key prefix; 64 KiB HTTP streaming, Content-Length check, reserve-before-append and total deadline. Actual local aiohttp reader tests: valid, oversized header, oversized stream, malformed/truncated pickle and incomplete timeout. No live S3 credentials/service used.
transport.compatibility: Completed reports/payloads remain visible to legacy server completion hooks until assignment/disconnect/close. Default urgent communication uses report.client_id for envelope, parts, completion, simulation filename and S3 reference.
